headline: Omaha have won every match since their October defeat
dek: Kansas City lead the table, but the only side to beat them in conference play was Omaha, whose 12 wins across the season are more than any other programme's. Since St. Thomas beat Omaha in October, Omaha have beaten Kansas City, Delaware, St. Thomas and Creighton in turn.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Across all matches, goals split the conference into an upper and a lower half, and Omaha's 47 are more than Oral Roberts and St. Thomas have scored together.

wire.line: Kansas City's only conference defeat came at Omaha, who have not lost since.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches have passed their date without a published result.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mark Ramarola, a defender, has six goals and six assists for Kansas City.

findings.text: Kamy Ndione has kept seven shutouts in Omaha's goal.
